items.tldr: Lenovo Yoga Slim 7i Aura Editionは、軽量デザインと鮮やかなディスプレイを備え、優れたバッテリー持続時間を実現しています。

items.title: JSR to build first Taiwan photoresist plant to co-develop advanced resists with TSMC — multi-million dollar plant could come online as early as 2028
items.description: The facility will close a gap that has put JSR at a disadvantage relative to its two largest Japanese rivals.
items.tldr: JSRは、2028年までに稼働予定の台湾のフォトレジスト工場を建設し、TSMCと共同で先進的なレジストを開発することで、日本の競合他社に対する競争力を強化します。

items.title: Apple considering Intel and Samsung for US chip production, report claims — consumer electronics giant looks to diversify supply chain amid chip shortages
items.description: Apple is reportedly in early talks with Intel and Samsung to secure more production for its advanced chips, as the company is constrained by the limited availability of advanced nodes that its SoCs are produced on.
items.tldr: Appleは、チップ不足の影響を受けて、IntelとSamsungとの初期交渉を行い、先進的なチップの生産を確保しようとしている。

items.title: Inland QN450 1TB SSD Review: Maximum efficiency, minimum spend
items.description: The Inland QN450 is a surprisingly capable Gen 4 drive with strong all-around performance and exceptional power efficiency. It outshines the NV3 but has hardware uncertainty and low TBW.
items.tldr: Inland QN450は、優れたパフォーマンスと卓越した電力効率を持つGen 4 SSDで、NV3よりも優れていますが、ハードウェアの不確実性と低いTBWが懸念されます。

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says China should not have Blackwell or Rubin AI GPUs — firmly states US should have 'the first, the most, and the best' when it comes to AI hardware
items.description: Nvidia's Jensen Huang reiterates that American companies should be able to ship their products globally, but maintains that the latest AI accelerators should remain in America.
items.tldr: NvidiaのCEOジェンセン・フアンは、中国にBlackwellやRubin AI GPUを提供すべきではないとし、AIハードウェアにおいてアメリカが「最初で、最も優れた」地位を持つべきだと強調した。

items.title: Apple Eyes Intel and Samsung Fabs in Early-Stage Talks, a Rare Crack in Its Decade-Long TSMC Loyalty
items.description: Apple has once again raised the possibility of making its chips at Fabs besides TSMC, as it is in early talks with Intel and Samsung. Intel & Samsung Emerge As Potential Fix To Apple's Supply Constraints Affecting Its Consumer Chips Bloomberg has just dropped some big news surrounding Apple, whi
items.tldr: AppleがTSMC以外のファブでチップを製造する可能性を探っており、IntelとSamsungとの初期段階の交渉に入っている。

items.title: Outstanding RTX 5080 combo bundle saves you $1,385 on a complete high-spec PC build — 64GB of RAM, 9850X3D, 2TB Samsung 9100 Pro, Corsair Case, and Power Supply for $2849
items.description: Every hardware component you need to build a top-tier gaming PC, all in one Newegg combo bundle. It also helps that it saves you a whopping $1,385 and includes a powerful RTX 5080 and 9850X3D.
items.tldr: 高性能ゲーミングPCを構築するためのRTX 5080と9850X3Dを含むハードウェアコンボバンドルが、$1,385の節約で$2,849で販売中です。

items.title: Save a massive $1,120 on this HP OLED gaming laptop with an RTX 5080 right now — Omen Max 16 rig ships with a 24-core Intel CPU, 32GB DDR5, 2TB SSD, and a 16-inch 1600p panel with a 240Hz refresh rate for less than $2,900
items.description: Grab a huge $1,120 saving on this RTX 5080 gaming laptop from HP, with 32GB DDR5, 2TB SSD, and a 16-inch OLED with a 240Hz refresh rate.
items.tldr: HPのRTX 5080ゲーミングラップトップが1,120ドルの割引で、32GB DDR5、2TB SSD、240Hzリフレッシュレートの16インチOLEDパネルを搭載し、2900ドル未満で販売中です。

items.title: AMD’s Ryzen X3D Chips Were So Fast They Broke Apex Legends Physics, Forcing Respawn to Patch the Game Around Them
items.description: Being fast can be a problem, well, you haven't heard that one right? Apex Legends developers just fixed an issue with physics calculations on AMD Ryzen X3D CPUs caused by their high single-threaded performance. Apex Legends Patch Addresses Physics Calculations-Based Stutters Encountered On CPUs With
items.tldr: AMDのRyzen X3D CPUの高いシングルスレッド性能が原因で、Apex Legendsの物理計算に問題が発生し、開発者がゲームを修正する必要があった。

items.title: CI Games Doubles Down on Lords of the Fallen 2’s Skimpy Armor After CEO’s Anti-‘Political Correctness’ Pivot: ‘You Wanted Provocative’
items.description: Around five months ago, CI Games CEO Marek Tyminski signaled a shift in tone for Lords of the Fallen 2 away from "political correctness" and toward, among other things, skimpy female armor designs. Now, that's been confirmed with the official reveal of five concept art pieces that leave little to im
items.tldr: CI GamesのCEOマレク・ティミンスキーが「政治的正しさ」からのシフトを示した後、『Lords of the Fallen 2』のスキンピーな女性用アーマーデザインが公式に確認され、コンセプトアートが公開された。

items.title: China pushes for 70% homegrown silicon wafer use as domestic firm ramps up 12-inch production — government seeking to localize critical chip supply chain amid AI boom and export restrictions
items.description: China is targeting 70% local wafer sourcing as firms like Eswin scale 12-inch production, aiming to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and support growing AI chip demand.
items.tldr: 中国は、AIチップ需要の増加に対応するため、国内企業Eswinが12インチシリコンウエハーの生産を拡大する中、70%の自給自足を目指している。

items.title: Notepad++ creator threatens legal action over macOS port of open-source app — developer says port is fine, but branding is too far
items.description: Notepad++ creator Don Ho has filed a trademark complaint with Cloudflare and is threatening further legal action against the developer of a macOS port.
items.tldr: Notepad++の創設者ドン・ホーが、macOSポートの開発者に対して商標侵害の苦情を申し立て、さらなる法的措置を脅かしています。

items.title: Intel's P-core Core 9 273PQE 'Bartlett Lake' CPU beats 14900K by up to 9% in gaming tests — embedded-only chip is unofficially Intel's fastest gaming CPU (at 720p)
items.description: A YouTuber has tested Intel's 12 P-core Core 9 273PQE and discovered the chip outperforms the Core i9-14900K by up to 9% in games potentially making the 273PQE Intel's fastest gaming CPU.
items.tldr: IntelのP-core Core 9 273PQEが、ゲームテストでCore i9-14900Kを最大9%上回り、非公式ながらIntelの最速ゲーミングCPUとされることが明らかになった。

items.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Part 3 Detailed Leak Is Setting Community Ablaze, But Could Be Too Good To Be True
items.description: Final Fantasy VII Remake Part 3 has yet to be officially announced, but recent statements from director Naoki Hamaguchi suggest the game's reveal and release aren't too far off. According to a high-effort leak posted on ResetEra, the third and final entry in the remake trilogy will be reve
items.tldr: ファイナルファンタジーVIIリメイクパート3の詳細なリークがコミュニティで話題になっているが、公式発表はまだなく、内容が真実であるか疑問視されている。ディレクターの濱口直樹は、ゲームの発表とリリースが近いことを示唆している。

items.title: Apple’s Chip Supply Crunch Is Affecting iPhone 17 Pro Max Shipments As Customer Claims A Single Unit Couldn’t Be Found In One U.S. State
items.description: The memory shortage faced by Apple can be avoided as the company can purchase DRAM quantities in bulk for a multitude of products, but one area where the Cupertino firm may continue to struggle is chip supply. As TSMC is operating at its maximum capacity by fulfilling 3nm silicon orders for AI custo
items.tldr: Appleのチップ供給不足がiPhone 17 Pro Maxの出荷に影響を及ぼしており、ある米国の州では単一のユニットが見つからないという顧客の報告がある。

items.title: Remedy’s New CEO Personally Vouches for CONTROL Resonant after Franchise Crosses 6 Million Units
items.description: This morning, Finnish developer Remedy Entertainment posted its Q1 2026 financial report, which revealed, among other things, a new sales milestone for CONTROL: 6 million units sold. The year's first quarter was profitable but slightly down year over year, with revenue falling 1.9% to €13.1 million,
items.tldr: Remedy EntertainmentがQ1 2026の財務報告を発表し、ゲーム「CONTROL」が600万ユニットを販売したことを明らかにしたが、全体の収益は前年同期比で1.9%減の1310万ユーロとなった。

items.title: OpenAI Picks MediaTek Over Qualcomm For Its First Smartphone, Customizing The Dimensity 9600 With A Dual-NPU Architecture To Challenge The iPhone
items.description: OpenAI appears to be fast-tracking its plans for an AI-enabled smartphone, partially in a bid to bolster its IPO that might land as soon as this year. And, in its urgency, OpenAI appears to be settling on a customized version of MediaTek's upcoming flagship Dimensity 9600 chip as the SoC of choice f
items.tldr: OpenAIは、AI対応スマートフォンの開発を加速させており、QualcommではなくMediaTekのDimensity 9600を選択し、iPhoneに対抗するためにデュアルNPUアーキテクチャをカスタマイズしています。

items.title: Apple Quietly Courts Intel And Samsung For Its Most Critical Chips As TSMC’s Advanced Nodes Remain Choked Under AI Demand
items.description: TSMC is turning into a victim of its own success as the world's preferred chip foundry, leaving its heretofore prized customers such as Apple in a bind of sorts as they suddenly find themselves crowded out by AI hyperscalers. In its frustration, Apple is now reportedly exploring the possibility of d
items.tldr: Appleは、AI需要の高まりによりTSMCの先進ノードが逼迫する中、IntelやSamsungとの関係を模索している。

items.title: Samsung Flaunts A Smartphone Display That Can Measure Blood Pressure With A Single Touch
items.description: Samsung might have a lot of faults, but a lack of innovation is certainly not among those. As a case in point, look no further than the recent SID exhibition in the United States, where Samsung just unveiled two revolutionary display technologies, unlocking a veritable suite of biomarker-led applica
items.tldr: Samsungは、アメリカのSID展示会で、1回のタッチで血圧を測定できるスマートフォンディスプレイを含む革新的なディスプレイ技術を発表しました。

items.title: Analyst Warns Google’s Intel TPU Bet Hinges on a Brutal Yield Jump From 90% to 98%
items.description: As rumors suggest that Google is interested in using Intel for its next-generation tensor processing unit (TPU) chips, well known analyst Ming-Chi Kuo has shared his thoughts on the matter. The analyst believes that yields will be a key factor in Google's decision, especially since the technology gi
items.tldr: アナリストのミンチー・クオは、Googleが次世代TPUチップにIntelを使用することに関心を示しているとの噂に対し、90%から98%への厳しい歩留まりの向上が決定の重要な要素になると警告しています。

items.title: The Back Door Attackers Know About — and Most Security Teams Still Haven’t Closed
items.description: Every AI tool, workflow automation, and productivity app your employees connected to Google or Microsoft this year left something behind: a persistent OAuth token with no expiration date, no automatic cleanup, and in most organizations, no one watching it. Your perimeter controls don't see it. Your
items.tldr: TL;DR: 企業が使用するAIツールや自動化アプリが生成する永続的なOAuthトークンは、期限がなく自動的にクリーンアップされず、多くの組織で監視されていないため、セキュリティリスクとなっている。

items.title: How the Story of a USB Penetration Test Went Viral
items.description: Two decades ago Dark Reading posted its first blockbuster — a column by a pen tester who sprinkled rigged thumb drives around a credit union parking lot and let curious employees do the rest. This episode looks back at the history-making piece with its author Steve Stasiukonis, Dark Reading senior e
items.tldr: TL;DR: Dark Readingの初の大ヒット記事は、ペンテスターがクレジットユニオンの駐車場に改造したUSBドライブを散布し、従業員がそれを拾う様子を描いたもので、この記事の著者スティーブ・スタシウコニスがその歴史的な出来事を振り返る。

items.title: MetInfo CMS CVE-2026-29014 Exploited for Remote Code Execution Attacks
items.description: Threat actors are actively exploiting a critical security flaw impacting an open-source content management system (CMS) known as MetInfo, according to new findings from VulnCheck. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-29014 (CVSS score: 9.8), a code injection flaw that could result in arbitrary
items.tldr: TL;DR: MetInfo CMSのCVE-2026-29014という重大な脆弱性（CVSSスコア: 9.8）が悪用され、リモートコード実行攻撃が行われていることが報告されています。

items.title: Google now offers up to $1.5 million for some Android exploits
items.description: Google overhauls its Android and Chrome vulnerability rewards programs, offering bounties of up to $1.5 million for the most difficult exploits while scaling back payouts for flaws that artificial intelligence (AI) has made easier to find. [...]
items.tldr: GoogleはAndroidとChromeの脆弱性報奨プログラムを改訂し、最も困難なエクスプロイトに対して最大150万ドルの報酬を提供する一方で、AIによって見つけやすくなった欠陥の報酬は減額する。

items.title: DarkSword Malware
items.description: DarkSword is a sophisticated piece of malware—probably government designed—that targets iOS. Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) has identified a new iOS full-chain exploit that leveraged multiple zero-day vulnerabilities to fully compromise devices. Based on toolmarks in recovered p
items.tldr: DarkSwordは、政府が設計した可能性がある高度なマルウェアで、iOSを標的にしており、Googleの脅威インテリジェンスグループによって複数のゼロデイ脆弱性を利用した新しいフルチェーンエクスプロイトが特定されました。

items.title: We Scanned 1 Million Exposed AI Services. Here's How Bad the Security Actually Is
items.description: While the software industry has made genuine strides over the past few decades to deliver products securely, the furious pace of AI adoption is putting that progress at risk. Businesses are moving fast to self-host LLM infrastructure, drawn by the promise of AI as a force multiplier and the pressure
items.tldr: AIの急速な導入が、ソフトウェア業界のセキュリティ向上の進展を危うくしていることが明らかになった。特に、自己ホスティングされたLLMインフラの導入が進む中で、セキュリティの脆弱性が顕在化している。

items.title: Karakurt extortion gang ‘cold case’ negotiator gets 8.5 years in prison
items.description: A Latvian national extradited to the United States was sentenced to 8.5 years in prison for his "cold case" negotiator role in the Russian Karakurt ransomware group. [...]
items.tldr: ラトビア国籍の男が、ロシアのKarakurtランサムウェアグループにおける「冷凍事件」交渉者としての役割により、アメリカで8.5年の懲役刑を言い渡された。

items.title: CloudZ malware abuses Microsoft Phone Link to steal SMS and OTPs
items.description: A new version of the CloudZ remote access tool (RAT) is deploying a previously unseen malicious plugin called Pheno that hijacks the Microsoft Phone Link connection to steal sensitive codes from mobile devices. [...]
items.tldr: CloudZマルウェアの新バージョンが、Microsoft Phone Linkを悪用する新しい悪意のあるプラグインPhenoを展開し、モバイルデバイスからSMSやOTPを盗むことが報告されています。

items.title: ScarCruft Hacks Gaming Platform to Deploy BirdCall Malware on Android and Windows
items.description: The North Korea-aligned state-sponsored hacking group known as ScarCruft has compromised a video game platform in a supply chain espionage attack, trojanizing its components with a backdoor called BirdCallto likely target ethnic Koreans residing in China. While prior versions of the backdoor have pr
items.tldr: 北朝鮮に関連するハッキンググループScarCruftが、サプライチェーン攻撃を通じてゲームプラットフォームを侵害し、BirdCallというバックドアを仕込んで中国に住む韓国系住民を標的にしている。

items.title: ScarCruft hackers push BirdCall Android malware via game platform
items.description: The North Korean hacker group APT37 has been delivering an Android version of a backdoor called BirdCall in a supply-chain attack through a video game platform. [...]
items.tldr: 北朝鮮のハッカーグループAPT37が、ゲームプラットフォームを通じてBirdCallというバックドアのAndroid版を供給網攻撃で配布している。

items.title: Weaver E-cology RCE Flaw CVE-2026-22679 Actively Exploited via Debug API
items.description: A critical security vulnerability in Weaver (Fanwei) E-cology, an enterprise office automation (OA) and collaboration platform, has come under active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerability (CVE-2026-22679, CVSS score: 9.8) relates to a case of unauthenticated remote code execution affecting Wea
items.tldr: Weaver E-cologyにおける重大なセキュリティ脆弱性（CVE-2026-22679）が、デバッグAPIを通じて積極的に悪用されており、CVSSスコアは9.8です。

items.title: Microsoft Details Phishing Campaign Targeting 35,000 Users Across 26 Countries
items.description: Microsoft has disclosed details of a large-scale credential theft campaign that has leveraged a combination of code of conduct-themed lures and legitimate email services to direct users to attacker-controlled domains and steal authentication tokens. The multi-stage campaign, observed between April 1
items.tldr: Microsoftは、26カ国で35,000人のユーザーを標的にした大規模なフィッシングキャンペーンの詳細を明らかにし、行動規範をテーマにした誘引と正当なメールサービスを利用して、攻撃者が制御するドメインにユーザーを誘導し認証トークンを盗む手法を説明しました。

items.title: Weaver E-cology critical bug exploited in attacks since March
items.description: Hackers have been exploiting a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-22679) in the Weaver E-cology office automation since mid-March to run discovery commands. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: ハッカーは、3月中旬からWeaver E-cologyの重要な脆弱性（CVE-2026-22679）を悪用し、発見コマンドを実行している。

items.title: RMM Tools Fuel Stealthy Phishing Campaign
items.description: Attackers are abusing two remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools to evade detection in a campaign that has impacted over 80 organizations so far.
items.tldr: 攻撃者は、80以上の組織に影響を与えたキャンペーンで、検出を回避するために2つのリモート監視管理（RMM）ツールを悪用しています。

items.title: Amazon SES increasingly abused in phishing to evade detection
items.description: The Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) is being increasingly abused to send convincing phishing emails that can bypass standard security filters and render reputation-based blocks ineffective. [...]
items.tldr: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES)がフィッシングメールの送信に悪用され、標準的なセキュリティフィルターを回避し、評判ベースのブロックが無効化されるケースが増加しています。

items.title: Exploit Cyber-Frenzy Threatens Millions via Critical cPanel Vulnerability
items.description: Shortly after the authentication-bypass flaw was disclosed multiple proof-of-concept exploits appeared, and one researcher claims there's been zero-day activity for at least a month.
items.tldr: cPanelの認証バイパス脆弱性が公開された後、複数の実証コンセプトのエクスプロイトが登場し、研究者は少なくとも1ヶ月間のゼロデイ活動があったと報告しています。

items.title: Phishing Campaign Hits 80+ Orgs Using SimpleHelp and ScreenConnect RMM Tools
items.description: An active phishing campaign has been observed targeting multiple vectors since at least April 2025 with legitimate Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) software as a way to establish persistent remote access to compromised hosts. The activity, codenamed VENOMOUS#HELPER, has impacted over 80 organi
items.tldr: TL;DR: 2025年4月以降、VENOMOUS#HELPERというコードネームのフィッシングキャンペーンが、80以上の組織を標的にし、正規のリモート監視管理（RMM）ツールを利用して持続的なリモートアクセスを確立する手法が観察されています。

items.title: Backdoored PyTorch Lightning package drops credential stealer
items.description: A malicious version of the PyTorch Lightning package published on the Python Package Index (PyPI) delivers a credential-stealing payload targeting browsers, environment files, and cloud services. [...]
items.tldr: 悪意のあるPyTorch LightningパッケージがPython Package Index（PyPI）に公開され、ブラウザや環境ファイル、クラウドサービスを狙った認証情報を盗むペイロードを配信しています。

items.title: Progress Patches Critical MOVEit Automation Bug Enabling Authentication Bypass
items.description: Progress Software has released updates to address two security flaws in MOVEit Automation, including a critical bug that could result in an authentication bypass. MOVEit Automation (formerly Central) is a secure, server-based managed file transfer (MFT) solution used to schedule and automate file mo
items.tldr: Progress Softwareは、MOVEit Automationの認証バイパスを引き起こす可能性のある重大なバグを含む2つのセキュリティ脆弱性に対処するためのアップデートをリリースしました。

items.title: Trellix discloses data breach after source code repository hack
items.description: Cybersecurity firm Trellix disclosed a data breach after attackers gained access to "a portion" of its source code repository. [...]
items.tldr: Trellixは、攻撃者がソースコードリポジトリの「一部」にアクセスしたことによりデータ侵害を公表しました。
